title: axum-core extractor traits
summary:
Core FromRequest/FromRequestParts traits, extension traits, default body limit, FromRef, tuple impls and extractor rejections shared by axum and axum-extra.

Agent mapper reason: These files define the extraction contract that all handlers depend on; they are reviewed together because they share traits and rejection behavior.
